readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, at the start of the New Year's Eve dinner, before watches were shown
Shown by Félix when everyone at table was made to show their watches, after the temple struck nine
While Madame and Casimir were playing piquet in the salon, before Casimir went out for his cigars
A moment after Casimir came back, when the hall clock struck eleven

durations: twenty minutes (Félix's watch, at 8:40, was twenty minutes behind the temple's nine o'clock strike)
a moment (between Casimir's return and the hall clock striking eleven)
whereabouts: Félix was at the dinner table when everyone was made to show their watches after the temple struck nine.
Aurèle was at the dinner table at nine o'clock, where he scolded Félix about his watch.
Monsieur Girard was at the dinner table at nine o'clock.
The doctor was at the dinner table at nine o'clock.
Madame and Casimir played piquet in the salon after dinner.
Casimir went out to fetch his cigars during the piquet game, after the temple struck ten.
Madame sat down at the piano and played Chopin while Casimir was out.
Madame stopped playing the piano when Casimir came back in.
Casimir came back in, and a moment later the hall clock struck eleven.
